recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision explicitly revisits whether initial or answerOption.initialSelected should be the required defaulting mechanism.
issue_request: FHIR-22686 originally requested removal of Questionnaire invariant que-11 because it blocked item.initial for questions with answerOption. The final Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: keep the invariant and revise its English description to say that when answerOption is present, initial[x] must be missing and answerOption.initialSelected should be used instead.
initial_application: Commit 8e4b30c6569a4e16ab1523a76f7b6365e0d4feff applied FHIR-22686 by changing the que-11 human text in source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml to include the answerOption.initialSelected guidance. Later source rewrites changed the displayed element name from initial[x] to initial, but preserved the same expression and rule.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml is in build scope. The 2020 SDC minutes record the 9-0-0 decision to reopen FHIR-22686 and keep answerOption.initialSelected as the required mechanism. Zulip discussions in 2020 and 2022 document rationale and implementation friction but no final reversal. Related FHIR-27803 and FHIR-41174 are already represented on the combined branch and do not change que-11.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because current que-11 still prohibits answerOption and initial together via answerOption.empty() or initial.empty(), still points to answerOption.initialSelected, and is attached to the relevant Questionnaire.item.answerOption and Questionnaire.item.initial elements.

related_jiras.note: Same SDC decision set removed a confusing initialSelected comment and relied on que-11 guidance; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Later Applied issue added que-17 to constrain multiple initialSelected options on non-repeating items without changing que-11; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Later Resolved - No Change issue confirms the problematic R4 initialSelected comment had already been removed in R5 and did not require new core changes.
